tools.name: sanctions__screen-uk

tools.name: sanctions__screen-us

tools.name: sanctions__wallet-screen

tools.name: companies-house__alphabetical-search

tools.name: companies-house__dissolved-search
tools.description: Search dissolved and removed companies by name. A few free samples a day, then $0.003 USDC per call via x402.

tools.name: companies-house__profile

tools.name: companies-house__registered-office
tools.description: Current registered office address. A few free samples a day, then $0.002 USDC per call via x402.

tools.name: companies-house__filing-history
tools.description: Accounts, confirmation statements, appointments and other filings, newest first. A few free samples a day, then $0.005 USDC per call via x402.

tools.name: companies-house__filing
tools.description: One filing's detail and document link. A few free samples a day, then $0.003 USDC per call via x402.

tools.name: companies-house__charges
tools.description: Mortgages and charges registered against a company, with lenders and status. A few free samples a day, then $0.008 USDC per call via x402.

tools.name: companies-house__insolvency
tools.description: Insolvency cases, practitioners and key dates for a company. A few free samples a day, then $0.008 USDC per call via x402.

tools.name: companies-house__exemptions
tools.description: PSC disclosure exemptions a company holds. A few free samples a day, then $0.002 USDC per call via x402.

tools.name: companies-house__uk-establishments
tools.description: UK branches of an overseas company. A few free samples a day, then $0.002 USDC per call via x402.

tools.name: companies-house__search
tools.description: Find UK companies by name or number, with status, address and incorporation date. A few free samples a day, then $0.003 USDC per call via x402.

tools.name: companies-house__advanced-search
tools.description: Filter companies by name, status, SIC code, location and incorporation dates. A few free samples a day, then $0.005 USDC per call via x402.

tools.name: uk-business__due-diligence
tools.description: Register profile plus risk flags: status, overdue accounts or confirmation statement, late accounts, insolvency history, Gazette notices, recent name/office changes, LEI and sanctions name screen. Costs $0.08 USDC per call via x402.

tools.name: uk-disputes__complaints-contact
tools.description: Verified complaints address, email, phone and URL for a UK company (energy, telecoms, water, finance…). A few free samples a day, then $0.003 USDC per call via x402.

tools.name: uk-disputes__organisations
tools.description: Organisations in the complaints directory, private parking operators and UK councils (with London flag). A few free samples a day, then $0.001 USDC per call via x402.

tools.name: uk-disputes__energy-complaint
tools.description: Back-billing (12-month rule) check, Ombudsman timeline and cited rules for a UK energy complaint. A few free samples a day, then $0.01 USDC per call via x402.

tools.name: uk-disputes__telecoms-complaint
tools.description: ADR timeline (6 or 8 weeks), price-rise rules and penalty-free exit window for a UK telecoms complaint. A few free samples a day, then $0.01 USDC per call via x402.

tools.name: uk-disputes__water-complaint
tools.description: Two-stage complaint, CCW referral and Guaranteed Standards Scheme timeline (England & Wales). A few free samples a day, then $0.01 USDC per call via x402.

tools.name: uk-disputes__parking-appeal
tools.description: Council PCN or private charge: route, deadlines, grounds, tribunal, cited law and strategy. A few free samples a day, then $0.01 USDC per call via x402.

tools.name: uk-disputes__consumer-charge
tools.description: Subscription, gym, retailer or tradesperson charge: rules that apply (Consumer Rights Act 2015), what to ask for, and the escalation ladder to a small claim. Regulated claims are signposted instead. A few free samples a day, then $0.01 USDC per call via x402.

tools.name: uk-gazette__notice
tools.description: Structured detail for one deceased-estates notice: address, date of death, executor and claim deadline. A few free samples a day, then $0.02 USDC per call via x402.

tools.name: uk-gazette__deceased-estates
tools.description: Search UK deceased-estates notices by the deceased's name, optionally narrowed to a year of death. A few free samples a day, then $0.01 USDC per call via x402.

tools.name: uk-legislation__item
tools.description: Title, long title, enactment/made date, status, extent, count of outstanding changes and the full table of contents. Free within the daily allowance, then $0.003 USDC per call via x402.

tools.name: uk-legislation__changes
tools.description: Most recent 50 changes (substitutions, repeals, insertions…) made by later legislation, with the amending provision, in-force dates and whether the change is reflected in the text yet. Free within the daily allowance, then $0.003 USDC per call via x402.

tools.name: uk-legislation__latest
tools.description: The newest Acts and instruments published, optionally of one type. Free within the daily allowance, then $0.001 USDC per call via x402.

tools.name: uk-legislation__types
tools.description: Type codes and what they mean. Free within the daily allowance, then $0.0005 USDC per call via x402.

tools.name: uk-legislation__search
tools.description: Find Acts and instruments by title words or full text, optionally by type and year. Free within the daily allowance, then $0.002 USDC per call via x402.

tools.name: uk-legislation__provision
tools.description: Plain numbered text of one section, regulation, article or schedule paragraph, as it stands today or on a past date, with amendment and commencement notes. Free within the daily allowance, then $0.003 USDC per call via x402.

tools.name: uk-tenders__search
tools.description: Contracts Finder notices by keyword, status (open, closed, awarded, withdrawn), type and publication date, optionally above a minimum value. Free within the daily allowance, then $0.003 USDC per call via x402.

tools.name: uk-tenders__notice
tools.description: One notice in full: description, CPV codes, contract dates, procedure and awards (supplier, value, dates). Accepts a Contracts Finder id (GUID) or a Find a Tender notice number (e.g. 095302-2026). Free within the daily allowance, then $0.002 USDC per call via x402.

tools.name: uk-tenders__supplier-awards
tools.description: Contracts Finder awards won by a supplier (name match), newest first, with total value. Free within the daily allowance, then $0.003 USDC per call via x402.

tools.name: uk-tenders__find-a-tender-latest
tools.description: Above-threshold UK notices published or updated on Find a Tender in the last 1–7 days, by stage (planning, tender, award), optionally filtered by keyword. Free within the daily allowance, then $0.003 USDC per call via x402.

tools.name: uk-trade-tariff__search
tools.description: Candidate commodity codes, headings and chapters for a product description ("roasted coffee", "lithium battery"), best match first. Free within the daily allowance, then $0.003 USDC per call via x402.

tools.name: uk-trade-tariff__commodity
tools.description: One commodity code: description, section/chapter/heading, third-country duty and every import/export measure (preferential rates, VAT, additional duties, controls with document codes). Give country to keep only what applies to that origin. Free within the daily allowance, then $0.002 USDC per call v

tools.name: uk-trade-tariff__heading
tools.description: A 4-digit heading and every commodity code under it, with indents and whether each is declarable. Free within the daily allowance, then $0.002 USDC per call via x402.

tools.name: uk-trade-tariff__quotas
tools.description: Quota definitions with status (open, exhausted, critical), initial volume, remaining balance and validity, by order number or country of origin. Free within the daily allowance, then $0.002 USDC per call via x402.

tools.name: uk-trade-tariff__areas
tools.description: Tariff geographical areas: countries and the groups used in measures (e.g. 1011 ERGA OMNES, 1013 European Union, trade agreements), with group members. Free within the daily allowance, then $0.002 USDC per call via x402.

tools.name: uk-trade-tariff__exchange-rates
tools.description: HMRC's monthly exchange rates used to convert invoice values for customs and import VAT, units per £1. Free within the daily allowance, then $0.002 USDC per call via x402.

tools.name: vat__rates
tools.description: Standard, reduced and super-reduced VAT rates for one country or all of EU27 + UK, with the date they were checked. Free within the daily allowance, then $0.001 USDC per call via x402.

tools.name: vat__calculate
tools.description: Net to gross or gross to net at a given rate, or at a country's standard rate. Free within the daily allowance, then $0.001 USDC per call via x402.

tools.name: vat__validate-format
tools.description: Country format and check digit for UK (GB/XI) and EU VAT numbers. Does not confirm registration. Free within the daily allowance, then $0.001 USDC per call via x402.
